Name: Industrialization Plus for PFM
Author: Zaerosz
Description:
Created by DraLUSAD and maintained by kazuakisama, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5102?tab=description]Industrialization for PFM[/url] features a wide array of machines designed to make your midgame and endgame progress less tedious in a fair and relatively balanced manner. Of particular note here are the Industrial Distillery and Preservative Press - upgrades to the basic Keg and Preserve Jar that process items in batches of five, work at double speed, and retain input quality. The Distillery in particular also features support for some mods that add recipes to the basic Keg by providing equivalent versions for its counterpart.

Industrialization Plus aims to bring this efficiency to the wider world of mods, by providing upgraded versions of PFM machines from just about every mod I can find that adds PFM recipes and, in the case of creating new machines, every mod I can get asset permissions for!

[b]Feel free to post compatibility requests in the comments, but please be patient! In addition, please report any bugs you find so I can fix them![/b]
